method.step_2: Weekly forecast uses the week-of-month share from the same store, flavor, and month across the previous 5 years.
method.week_definition: Week 1 = days 1-7, Week 2 = days 8-14, Week 3 = days 15-21, Week 4 = days 22-28, Week 5 = days 29-end.
method.step_1: Monthly forecast is the average of the same month across the previous 5 years, with missing years treated as zero.
